title: They voted to end the Iran war, then they paid for it
body: Six House Democrats voted twice for war powers resolutions telling Trump to end his war on Iran. Then they voted to fund it. The Lever reports that Don Davis, Henry Cuellar, Jared Golden, Adam Gray, Vicente Gonzalez, and Marie Gluesenkamp Perez all backed the fiscal 2027 defense bill, a record $1.15 trillion package that bankrolls the same military campaign they said they wanted stopped. The NDAA squeaked through 216 to 212. Do the math on a four-vote margin with six Democrats crossing the aisle. They didn't just support the war budget. They were the reason it passed.

The timing makes it worse. One of those war powers resolutions cleared the House just one day after the defense vote. So these members put their names on the bill that funds the war, then a day later signed a resolution demanding the war end. The Hill and NOTUS both logged the same six names handing Republicans the win.
A war powers resolution with no money behind it is a press release. The budget is where the real position lives. Six Democrats just told you theirs.
